purpose: concept thumbnails mapped to existing decorating catalog, not exact model renders

assets.subject: One small closed oak supply barrel, bulging staves, two broad dark iron hoops with aged brass rivets, round wooden lid visible. No objects on or around it.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent furniture thumbnail for a fantasy shop decoration UI, final PNG requested 1024x1024.
Input image: reference image only; use the isolated furniture thumbnails in its left sidebar as the visual style target. Do not reproduce the screenshot, UI, text, background or frame.
Subject: One small closed oak supply barrel, bulging staves, two broad dark iron hoops with aged brass rivets, round wooden lid visible. No objects on or around it.
Style: high quality warm realistic painterly 3D game asset, gently stylized proportions, well-defined natural wood grain and brass/dark metal surface details, clean silhouette legible at 100px. Similar material richness and warm lighting to the reference left-sidebar furniture thumbnails. Not cartoon outline, not flat vector.
Composition: single complete centered object, high three-quarter/isometric view looking down about 30 degrees, front and right face visible, all parts within 10 percent transparent margins on every side, no clipping.
Lighting: soft warm upper-left key light with soft natural self-shadow and restrained highlights, ambient fill so dark-side details remain readable.
Background: genuine transparent alpha channel everywhere outside the object; transparent canvas, no floor or environment, no checkerboard painted in, no outer shadow or glow.
No text, letters, numbers, labels containing writing, logos, watermark, border, UI frame, pedestals, ground, other furniture or duplicate object.
